newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH ARSENAL SAYS BEATS JAN-APRIL SALES TARGET.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH ARSENAL SAYS BEATS JAN-APRIL SALES TARGET.

text.p: Finnish state-owned asset management company Arsenal Oy said in a statement on Thursday it had sold real estate for 622 million markka in January-April, exceeding its own first-tertial sales target by 223 million markka.
"The sales target for the first tertial was exceeded by 223 million markka," Arsenal said.
Arsenal quoted real estate director Seppo Lehto as saying that the full-year sales target was also likely to be exceeded, though it did not say what that target was.

"All signs suggest that the upturn on the real estate market is continuing," it quoted Lehto as saying. "This will lift business property leases and thereby returns and prices, and it will boost the number of transactions."
